The ISKCON centre of Noida at A-5, Sector 33 (opposite the NTPC office, on Maharaja Agrasen Marg). IDENTITY CONFIRMED. Founded in the Gaudiya Vaishnava lineage of A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada (ISKCON founder acharya). The complex houses a large temple room, auditorium, guesthouse, educational wing, a museum (ticketed), and Govinda's pure-vegetarian restaurant; free lunch prasadam is served daily 11:30 AM-2:00 PM. A weekly Harinam Sankirtan goes through Noida every Saturday. INAUGURATION DATE UNVERIFIED - flag for confirmation.
